faucetNote: The preprod faucet dispenses tNIGHT and only accepts the UNSHIELDED address (mn_addr_test1…). The shielded address above is rejected as 'Provided address is invalid'. The @midnight-ntwrk/wallet SDK only derives the shielded side; the unshielded address is exposed by Lace. Import the 24-word seed (stored as the MIDNIGHT_WALLET_SEED secret) into Lace on Midnight preprod to reveal the unshielded address, then paste that into the faucet. After tNIGHT arrives, click 'Generate tDUST' in Lace to delegate — deploys spend tDUST.
